meta.title: Web Embed
meta.description: Embed external web pages or stream/video URLs in TX-5DR panels.
meta.readmeMarkdown:
# web-iframe-embed

Embed external web pages or stream/video URLs in TX-5DR operator panels and the
automation popover.

## Features

- Per-operator URL settings for two panel placements
- Auto-detects HLS (`.m3u8`) and common direct video links
- Uses iframe mode for regular pages and video mode for media URLs
- For same-origin embedded iframes, forwards keyboard events to the TX-5DR host
  so host-level shortcuts such as Voice PTT still work while the embedded page is
  focused
- Localized in English and Chinese

## Forwarding shortcuts from cross-origin pages

Browsers do not allow this plugin to listen to keyboard events inside arbitrary
cross-origin iframes. If you control the embedded page, add a small opt-in bridge
to that page so PTT candidate keys can be forwarded to TX-5DR:

```html
<script>
(() => {
  const MESSAGE_TYPE = 'tx5dr:web-iframe-embed:keyboard';
  const PTT_CODES = new Set([
    'Backquote',
    'Space',
    'Home',
    'F1',
    'F2',
    'F3',
    'F4',
    'F5',
    'F6',
    'F7',
    'F8',
    'F9',
    'F10',
    'F11',
    'F12',
  ]);

  const forward = (event) => {
    if (!PTT_CODES.has(event.code)) {
      return;
    }

    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    window.parent.postMessage({
      type: MESSAGE_TYPE,
      eventType: event.type,
      code: event.code,
      key: event.key,
      repeat: event.repeat,
      altKey: event.altKey,
      ctrlKey: event.ctrlKey,
      metaKey: event.metaKey,
      shiftKey: event.shiftKey,
      location: event.location,
    }, '*');
  };

  window.addEventListener('keydown', forward, { capture: true });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', forward, { capture: true });
})();
</script>
```

The plugin only accepts these messages from the currently embedded iframe. The
TX-5DR host still decides whether a forwarded key is an active shortcut.

## Build

```bash
npm install
npm run build
```

en.pluginDescription: Embeds external web pages or stream/video URLs into multiple TX-5DR panel positions.
en.globalLayoutGuideDescription:
These URLs are shared by all operators.

[Main screen]
Left content | Center content | Right extension pane

[Voice mode]
Left: above the frequency control panel
Right: the whole upper-right panel

[CW mode]
Left: above the frequency control panel
en.embedNoticeDescription: Regular web pages are embedded directly. Stream URLs switch to the built-in video player automatically. Autoplay is muted by default, and some sites may still refuse embedding because of their own policy.
en.rememberAspectRatioDescription: When enabled, manually resizing a supported panel saves its width/height ratio instead of only its height, then updates height automatically when the panel width changes.
en.operatorLayoutGuideDescription:
This URL only applies to the current operator.

[Operator card]
The full card content area renders the configured page here.
en.operatorCardUrlDescription: Only applies to the current operator and renders inside the operator card content area.
en.automationPopoverUrlDescription: Global URL shown in the automation popover panel.
en.emptyDescription: Set a URL in this operator's plugin settings to render content here.
en.invalidDescription: Only http:// and https:// URLs are supported.
en.iframeHint: If the area stays blank or shows a refusal page, the target site is likely blocking iframe embedding with its own policy.
en.videoHint: Media URLs switch to a built-in player. Autoplay starts muted to maximize browser compatibility.
en.videoAutoplayFailed: Autoplay is ready but blocked. Click play to continue.
en.videoLoadFailed: Unable to load this video stream.
en.hlsLoadFailed: Unable to load the HLS stream.
en.mainRightPaneUrlLabel: Main right extension pane page URL
en.mainRightPaneUrlDescription: Global URL shown in the far-right extension pane of the main screen.
en.voiceLeftTopUrlLabel: Voice left frequency panel upper page URL
en.cwLeftTopUrlLabel: CW left frequency panel upper page URL
en.voiceLeftTopUrlDescription: Global URL shown above the frequency control panel in voice mode.
en.cwLeftTopUrlDescription: Global URL shown above the frequency control panel in CW mode.
en.voiceRightTabsDescription: Add, rename, or remove global web tabs shown in the voice-mode upper-right panel.

zh.pluginDescription: 在 TX-5DR 的多个面板位置中嵌入外部网页或流媒体/视频 URL。
zh.globalLayoutGuideDescription:
这些 URL 对所有操作员共用。

[主界面]
左侧内容 | 中间内容 | 右侧扩展面板

[语音模式]
左侧：频率控制面板上方
右侧：整个右侧上方面板

[CW 模式]
左侧：频率控制面板上方
zh.embedNoticeDescription: 普通网页会直接嵌入显示；流媒体 URL 会自动切换到视频播放器。默认静音自动播放，但部分站点仍可能因自身策略拒绝被嵌入。
zh.rememberAspectRatioDescription: 开启后，支持拖拽的面板会保存宽度/高度比例，而不是只保存高度；当面板宽度变化时会自动按比例更新高度。
zh.operatorLayoutGuideDescription:
这个 URL 仅对当前操作员生效。

[操作员卡片]
整个卡片内容区域都会显示这里配置的网页。
zh.operatorCardUrlLabel: 操作员卡片内网页地址
zh.operatorCardUrlDescription: 仅对当前操作员生效，显示在操作员卡片内容区域。
zh.automationPopoverUrlLabel: 自动化弹出面板网页地址
zh.automationPopoverUrlDescription: 全局生效，显示在自动化弹出面板中。
zh.emptyDescription: 请在当前操作员的插件设置中填写 URL，内容才会显示在这里。
zh.invalidDescription: 仅支持 http:// 和 https:// URL。
zh.iframeHint: 如果这里一直空白或显示拒绝加载，通常是目标站点通过自身策略禁止 iframe 嵌入。
zh.videoHint: 媒体 URL 会切换为内置播放器。为了尽可能兼容浏览器自动播放策略，会默认静音播放。
zh.videoAutoplayFailed: 已经准备好播放，但自动播放被拦截。请点击播放继续。
zh.hlsLoadFailed: 无法加载 HLS 流媒体。
zh.mainRightPaneUrlLabel: 主面板右侧扩展面板网页地址
zh.mainRightPaneUrlDescription: 全局生效，显示在主面板最右侧的扩展面板中。
zh.voiceLeftTopUrlLabel: 语音左侧频率控制面板上方网页地址
zh.cwLeftTopUrlLabel: CW 左侧频率控制面板上方网页地址
zh.voiceLeftTopUrlDescription: 全局生效，显示在语音模式左侧频率控制面板上方。
zh.cwLeftTopUrlDescription: 全局生效，显示在 CW 模式左侧频率控制面板上方。
zh.voiceRightTabsDescription: 新增、重命名或删除显示在语音模式右侧上方面板中的全局网页标签页。
